_doc: The Plan's sections, glance band, themes grid and two-list sidebar (ov-503, ov-872): inputs are plan --json shapes as the runner sends them (plan.json's keys), and `expect` is what AgentKit's PlanSectionsCasesTests and Android's PlanSectionsCasesTest must both produce, lowercased since iOS says titles in title case and Android in sentence case. Regenerate `expect` with FARCOOLER_REGENERATE_CASES=<path> on Android's test, read it, then copy it in. now_ms is 1800000000000.
